items.question: How do I schedule an initial consultation?
items.answer: You can schedule a consultation directly by submitting the form below or contacting our chambers via phone or email. Our practice manager will review your matter and schedule a conference with the appropriate senior advocate or CA within 24 hours.

items.question: What areas of law and financial advisory do you specialize in?
items.answer: We specialize in Civil & Commercial Litigation, Corporate Governance & M&A, Direct & Indirect Taxation (GST), Statutory Audits, Real Estate & RERA matters, and Family Office Estate Trusts.

items.question: How are legal and chartered accounting fees structured?
items.answer: We maintain transparent fee schedules based on retainer arrangements, stage-wise litigation milestones, or fixed project fees for audits and corporate registrations, agreed in writing upfront.

items.question: Will all information shared with your firm remain confidential?
items.answer: Strict confidentiality is our foremost duty. All communications and documentation are protected by advocate-client privilege under the Indian Evidence Act as well as professional secrecy codes of ICAI.

items.question: Can you represent clients in online / virtual tribunal hearings?
items.answer: Yes. Our advocates regularly appear in virtual proceedings before the Supreme Court, High Courts across India, NCLT, ITAT, and Consumer Forums.

items.question: Do you offer integrated legal and tax support for new startups?
items.answer: Absolutely. We provide end-to-end launch packages including entity incorporation, shareholder agreements, trademark filings, GST setup, and continuous statutory compliance.
